label: Подключить готовый Z.ai site driver к общему browser AHAP runner
description: Текущий runner принимает только AHAP_HARNESS=chatgpt. Переиспользовать существующий Z.ai driver с тем же явным transport/page/account contract; одна dispatchфункция, capabilities factual. No newtransport/driver rewrite.
acceptance: Configured harness chatgpt/zai реально создаёт соответствующий adapter; capabilities/harness неhardcodeChatGPT, unknownmode/page/account failsbeforemutation; tests both, scopedpublish. НативныйZ.ai отдельный QZAICASE; не обходить missingaccountproof, CI driverfilesне трогать.

progress_events.note: Работаю в предоставленном изолированном worktree; перед кодом подтверждены runner ChatGPT-only, существующий Z.ai driver/factory и ограничение account proof на пустом списке.
Scoped source result published and remote-proven; empty-account proof limitation documented; native acceptance separate.

changes.result: Source-only factory published as 4489c69bcf6a24ab7457161ed158eda4a1a6fdc8 on main; remote SHA confirmed. Existing Z.ai driver is selected via the explicit shared Mac Mini transport and exact page; reads perform fresh expected-scope checks. Focused runner tests 15/15 pass. The existing Z.ai proof cannot establish scope for an empty list; that precise limitation is recorded and fails closed. Native Z.ai/browser acceptance is not claimed. Evidence: evidence/QZAIFACTORY-main-publish-20261107.md.
changes.note: Evidence: evidence/QZAIFACTORY-main-publish-20261107.md. Known contract limit: current Z.ai scope derives from a listed chat's user_id; empty/unverifiable list fails closed. Native Z.ai acceptance remains separate; no browser mutation/send performed.
